notes.title: READ THIS AFTER EXAM
notes.content:
Hey Ayuly,

Exams are finally over — congrats, you survived.
Remember how motivated you were about getting good at pwn, heap exploits, malware reversing, IoT firmware, kernel stuff?
Don't let it die again.

Start **today** with the stupid-small version:
- Create/open the exploit-lab GitHub repo
- Set the phone wallpaper checklist (or just do the items below)
- Touch one tool for literally 1–5 minutes: gdb, Ghidra, Binwalk, Volatility, QEMU...
- Write one sentence in the daily note: "Restarted – looked at ___"

Core reminders:
- Systems thinking: How does X interact with memory/OS/hardware?
- Debugging mindset: Every crash = puzzle
- Iteration: One problem → 10 variants
- Ethical: Isolated VMs only
- Lab: Dual-boot, QEMU, tools installed

You already know the session ritual and checklist — just follow the micro version first.
You've got this. Tiny steps every day = real skill in 3–6 months.

Start now. Open the repo/tool/note. 5 minutes. Go.
